title: Keeping direction and making room for play

captions.physics: Moving together towards a chosen aim
captions.energy: Following an absorbing promise of enjoyment
captions.emotions: Meeting an unexpected turn with lightness

meaning: Lightness supports shared leisure when a strong promised experience leaves you free to change direction through living interest.
text: A chosen aim can gather leisure into absorbing movement. The Chariot in the physical position of Svadhisthana helps keep a course and follow the path together. The Devil in energy holds the promise of a special experience until leaving the route feels difficult. The Fool in emotions allows a light response to something unexpected. Action heads towards the aim, the motive binds you to its promise and feeling is ready to play with the new. Lightness remains available while direction permits a free revision by both people.

For example, you walk towards a well known street performance. On the way, a small stage with an amusing puppet act catches both your attention. **A shared path can turn towards what already interests you.** There is no need to hurry towards the larger promised spectacle if delight appeared here. You can watch the short act and decide afterwards. Agreement survives a changed aim and gains a living form beyond justifying the planned route.

The difficulty is treating a turn as losing the distance already invested. You hurry onwards for something expected to be better and miss present pleasure. Spontaneity is permitted only after the compulsory goal. Leisure becomes more serious than you wanted. Free participation includes choosing what you see now, restoring the possibility of enjoyment without a hidden demand to reach the promised reward.
